source:
@@U04292@@
We risked our lives, we'll take our share of the loot! That’s war, this is the enemy’s tent, and we're soldiers the same as you!

@@U04294@@
Not in this army you're not! We're soldiers, not thieves. Only honest men serve our Emperor.

@@U04296@@
Yes, and we know your kind of honest. You call it “Contribution,” but it’s more like “Hand it over!” Youre all the same!

@@U04297@@
(To 快掠女.)

@@U04298@@
Take what you've got and get out! I think we've worn out our welcome.

@@U04299@@
(Exeunt 抢夺者 and 快掠女.)

@@U04301@@
You had the chance, why didn’t you knock his teeth down his throat?

@@U04303@@
I suddenly felt weak— the two of them looking so ghostly.

@@U04305@@
I suddenly couldn't see straight, spots and all.

@@U04307@@
I don’t quite know how to say it. All day was so close, so hot and muggy you could hardly breathe—
translation:
@@U04292@@
我们冒着生命危险，我们会拿走我们的那份战利品！这就是战争，这是敌人的帐篷，我们和你们一样都是士兵！

@@U04294@@
你不属于这支军队！我们是战士，不是小偷。只有诚实的人才能侍奉我们的皇帝。

@@U04296@@
是的，我们知道你很诚实。你称之为“贡献”，但它更像是“把它交给！”你们都一样！

@@U04297@@
（致快掠女。）

@@U04298@@
带上你所拥有的，出去吧！我想我们已经不再受到欢迎了。

@@U04299@@
（抢夺者、快掠女下。）

@@U04301@@
你本来有机会，为什么不把他的牙齿打碎他的喉咙呢？

@@U04303@@
我突然感到浑身无力——他们两个看上去好鬼一样。

@@U04305@@
我突然看不清东西了，有斑点等等。

@@U04307@@
我不太知道该怎么说。一整天都这么近了，又热又闷，你几乎无法呼吸——
